facts.text: First-year Early Action applicants selected as Immersive Scholars receive up to $4,000 in grant funding for research with faculty, community projects, or study abroad.

sources.title: Immersive Scholars | UMass Lowell
sources.quote: Immersive Scholars are pre-selected first-year applicants who receive a merit award of up to $4,000 to participate in approved experiential learning programs at UMass Lowell
